page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with no margin notes. Below the last line: signature "D 3" at left and catchword "est" at right.

main_text.l: noftræ multò pretiosiorem auro, quod perit, & tamen per ignem
probatur, reperiri in laudem & honorem & gloriam, tum cùm re-
velabitur Iesus Christus, &c. Esajas Cap.IV.3.4. fore, ut profliga-
ta hypocritarum colluvie sancti puríque & כתובי לחיים scripti in
libro vitæ, restent, edicit his verbis: Et erit qui relictus fuerit in Sion,

l.i: & residuus in Ierusalaim, קדוש יאמר לו Sanctus dicetur illi. Omnis
qui scriptus fuerit in vita, erit in Ierusalaim. Quando abluerit Dominus

main_text.l: sordes filiarum Sion, & sanguinem Ierusalaim laverit de medio ejus, ברוח
משפט וברוח עבר in Spiritu judicii, & in Spiritu ardoris. Et

l.i: creabit Iehova super omnem locum montis Sion, & super loca convoca-
tionis ejus, nubem per diem & fumum, & splendorem ignis flammantis

main_text.l: per noctem. Super omnem enim gloriam erit protectio. Ita igitur nul-
lum ex flagellis damnum ecclesia patitur: quia sic minuitur, ut mul-
tos hypocritas evomendo, tantundem levetur: quemadmodum
ægro corpori nonnisi purulenta vel fœtida materia ejecta, sanitas:
agro feraci & pingui nonnisi eradicato lolio fertilitas restitui po-
test. Tametsi enim Divinis judiciis non omnibus maculis ecclesia
ad liquidum purgatur, utpote quæ tum demum verè & solidè con-
spicua erit, cùm hœdi ab agnis separati fuerint: tamen pro magno
beneficio habendum, quoties ad legitimam munditiem propius ac-
cedit, & saltem partem sui nitoris recuperat. Illud inprimis suavis-
simum, quòd ecclesiæ sic purgatæ ibidem promittitur יומם
ענן ושען ונגה אש להבה לילה nubes per diem, & fumus ac splendor ignis
flammantis per noctem. quod symbolum ecclesiæ à servitute Ægyptia-
ca redemptæ, significat, non minùs insignibus modis gratiæ, favoris
& suæ ὡς συντελείας ἕ αἰῶνος usque ad consummationem Seculi præ-
sentiæ testimonium Deum ecclesiæ castigatæ patefacturum. Hæc
videlicet vis est illius צרפה πυρώσεως, ignitæ probationis, de qua præ-
ter loca Psal.LXVI.10.11. Esaj.I.25. Dan.XII.10. Malach.III.4. su-
periùs allegata, etiam fermo est Ezech.XXII.15.16. &c. ubi per
conflationem & liquefactionem argenti, æris, stanni, ferri & plumbi
in medio catini, se ablaturum ab ecclesia impuritatem Deus promit-
tit. Et sanè experientia omnium retro Seculorum locuples testis
est, quàm salutaris extiterit ecclesiæ omnium persecutionum
& cladium publicarum eventus. Remittente enim, sopito & extincto
persecutionum igne sævissimo, fideles hinc inde in mundo dispersi,
moribus vitæ longè puriores, fide constantiores, precibus arden-
tiores, patientiæ, tolerantiæ exemplis illustriores evaserunt. Testis
est

page.notes: The Greek and Hebrew phrases are copied as best I can read them at this scan resolution. Their letters, vowels and accents are doubtful, especially "ἕως συντελείας ἕ αἰῶνος", the Hebrew "יומם ענן ושען ונגה" and the word "צרפה". I left them unmarked where they seemed clear, so they should be checked against the original. The page has no printed page number and no running head. "D 3" is the gathering signature. The catchword "est" is printed as "eft" (long s); I have written it as est per the rules. The sentence "Tametsi" follows "po-teft." on the same line with no indent, so I treated it as continuing the paragraph rather than starting a new one.
